findings.title: Read the update bit without mutating shared frame flags, and restore query effects at probe boundary
findings.mechanism: world_fold calls get_local_entity_int_value(INT_TYPE_UPDATED) before the first measured query and again afterwards. Original mb_int.c:398 implements this getter as updated_entities[index] &= mask, clearing other entities bits in the same32-entity word. The observer therefore changes the state that en_cllsn.c:1330 uses to select old/new swept positions. A post-fold also clears bits. The original collision query itself calls that same destructive getter; that legacy effect must be distinguished from observer contamination.
findings.evidence: All three120s probe runs actually exit1 with world_unchanged=0; no-probe controls finish. The source-side mutation mechanism is verified; no isolated native flag-word diagnostic was retained, so attribution of every changed bit is not claimed. Boot smokes cannot establish full flag-state purity.
findings.bounded_correction: Use a fixture-only nondestructive raw-bit peek for observation. Snapshot the relevant full bounded flag state before the measured sweep; retain all original query calls/order and getter effects inside that sequence, record pre/post-query effects as legacy diagnostics, then restore at the probe boundary, including post-snapshot refusal/overflow paths. Assert restoration separately from measured query effects. Do not modify production &= or hide the mutation by omitting the field/world check. The flag arrays are bounded static arrays in up_update.c:86–88, not runtime heap maps. Add meaningful same-word/multiple-word/bit31 and refusal/restoration checks, then obtain new moving-original native evidence.

findings.title: Require exact conservation of the emitted positive type-hit buckets
findings.mechanism: The emitter writes every positive per-type bucket, but the checker only requires their sum <= group hit count. Deleting one or all positive col-entity-type rows still reaches successful coverage/done. The stand-in positive itself has12 structured hits but only4 bucket hits, which is impossible for the C emitter.
findings.bounded_correction: Require exact summed type-hit equality to each group hit count, and positive valid dynamic rows; correct the positive collaborator and add real-script missing-positive-row/all-positive-rows deletion controls. Actual d5 smoke buckets already conserve all hits, so retain those raw measurements unchanged.

findings.title: Check the targets the census necessarily supplies, not only upper bounds
findings.mechanism: Only maximum quotas/census bounds are checked. A positive census can be paired with under-selected or zero targets and consistently reduced case rows, then accepted as a coverage gap. The current positive stand-in has4 stationary candidates but selects only1+1, and40quad/60geometry trees with only2/1 selected; both contradict first3-per-class collection.
findings.bounded_correction: For each entity family with totalN and two geometry classes require min(N,3) <= selected_total <= min(N,6), alongside individual quotas and existing bounds, unless exact subgroup census is provided. Tree classes are already derivable: geometry target count=min(type1,3) when forest geometry exists, else0; quad count=min(type0,3) with geometry or min(total,3) without it. Repair positive fixtures to feasible emitter data and add under-selection controls. Do not invent collision hits or new physical expectations.

findings.title: Verify the floating-point mask assumption for all actual tree rays
findings.mechanism: The initial random ray checks zero x/z extents at1335, but shortened near-hit rays are passed directly through query_tree. A returned f32 hit point at large coordinates can round one component to the source while the other advances more than0.1m; the derived ray can then reach original en_cllsn.c:2021/2024 division with a zero extent. The declaration that such rays are never probed is not established; fegetround at1404 checks rounding, not exception masks. No actual unmasked exception/crash is claimed.
findings.bounded_correction: The lead-adopted minimal remedy is suitable: read/require all six exception masks in both x87 control word and SSE MXCSR before probing, without changing masks or original calls/generator/folds; count derived axis rays distinctly and correct unsupported wording, retaining legitimate vertical/short early-gate cases. Verify the new guard in a new named build; do not retroactively claim d5 recorded these control words.

findings.title: Embed the actual driver instead of looking for the build machine source path
findings.mechanism: run_collision_case substitutes env!(CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR)/lua into the stand-in, whose final dofile uses it. A Windows executable cross-built in the Linux container carries /src/... or another Linux-only path, so these new guard tests fail setup on Windows instead of testing the driver. Linux8/8 does not exercise portability.
findings.bounded_correction: Embed the actual collision driver with include_str and write it into a private per-test directory beside the collaborator, then run the real script there. Preserve existing guard assertions and run the cross-built tests on actual Windows; no campaign war is needed for this correction.

findings.title: State precisely which candidate state and warm answers are measured
findings.mechanism: world_fold traverses sector-list entities but not CITY_BUILDING children and contains no per-entity identity. Nearer warm query results at C:853/890 are discarded, while primary warm answers are counted. Header/API/docs claim every collision candidate state/list membership and per-query warm behavior are measured. No observed building/identity mutation is asserted.
findings.bounded_correction: Either extend the relevant guards or qualify the prose/counters to the exact sampled state and primary-query warm scope. This wording-only scope correction cannot resolve the independently observed P1 destructive-read defect.

scope: One combined new-source correctness, clean-code, boundary/FFI/lifetime/memory/FPU/RNG, driver-test and completed-original evidence review. No unchangedG1/G2/D2 review; no delegation. Reviewer used read-only files/JSON/hashing and wrote only this review; no supplied scripts/tests/compiler/native campaigns/process/cache/auth/Git operations/external writes were executed.
otherwise_observed: Fixture/API/Cargo feature gating is explicit; original entity/tree query calls remain the source of answers. No host ownership extraction or new physical solver is implemented.

Scalar C/Rust arguments match; counts are bounded0..20000, output buffer128KiB is initialized, vsnprintf reports overflow, C restores the shared terrain snapshot before report-overflow refusal, and Rust keeps the refusal reason. Static probe storage is protected by the existing serialized engine entry.

Inputs and output vectors are initialized before observing partial/miss writes; physical folds use actual scalar/vector bit patterns and address-free hit facts. The separate legacy fold uses private heap-slot/record diagnostics and must not become a generic host contract. Miss-write counters detect value changes from initialized output/sentinel, not instrumented identical-value stores.

Physical query formulas and original RNG calls are not rewritten. The private generators use statement-ordered draws. New fixture code does not set the game RNG. Native reported RNG equality is a bounded check, not proof of all simulator state.

This pre-G1 base uses original in-core terrain functions, so the hostless OBSERVE entry works here. A later G1 integration must re-check actual callback requirements; this review does not authorize retaining NULL host scope after new host-querying callers are composed.

linux_evidence.limits: Stand-in flow/schema/format/hostClippy only; no physical C/retail proof and no Windows guard portability proof.

smokes.limits: Boot seconds0, private200random cases/family, repeats2. Gapped stationary-world physical measurements only; no moving/aligned-fixed/geometry-tree proof, and Georgia no two-object scan-order ray. Reported world-state flags do not cure P1 or establish full observer purity.

long_controls.limits: All3probes stop after1200frames at report_invalid world_unchanged0; only3strict rows, no emitted collision measurement/report, no afterframes/digest/coverage/done. Failed Lebanon raw equality is reproducible failure only. The2controls complete1500frames and only identity/kind/side/alive digests. Probe/control digest comparison is UNAVAILABLE, not an observed digest inequality. No Tacview or complete recordings were generated.

Publication expressly distinguishes LF serialization from immutable private raw SHA fields. No raw coordinate samples/retail assets/binaries are in these two files. No independent Git-blob operation was performed under this task limit. Pending/live labels are historical metadata, not actual terminal proof.

remaining_limits: Corrections and meaningful new red/green checks/new named native fixture are required before accepting moving-original characterization or designing/accepting the production cutover. Keep d5 failures and prior valid measurements intact; no golden rewrite/tolerance change or production &= fix.

The original implementation has first-found scan/city exclusion, miss output and tree tie semantics to preserve or explicitly govern. This fixture does not yet establish all moving/aligned/geometry-tree/player/client/MP branches. Axis FP conditions are not retroactively verified by successful old runs.

G3 model/device/subobject/target-point/other spatial services, environment/time and physical loader/solver removal remain whole-D3 work. No Task49 delivery, G3 extraction, shipping, whole-D3 or GitHub APPROVED claim. Task47 shipping processes/inputs were untouched.
